final: WITH exec_by_type AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM orders o INNER JOIN orderexecutions oe ON o.recordvault = oe.ordersmark GROUP BY o.ordertune), totals AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) as total, COUNT(*) as num_types FROM exec_by_type), with_shares AS (SELECT ebt.ordertune, ebt.cnt, ebt.cnt * 1.0 / t.total as share, 1.0 / t.num_types as avg_share FROM exec_by_type ebt CROSS JOIN totals t), above_avg AS (SELECT ordertune, cnt, share, avg_share FROM with_shares WHERE share > avg_share) SELECT SUM(cnt) as sum_counts, AVG(share) as avg_share_above, AVG(share - avg_share) as avg_excess FROM above_avg
